## Birthweight Z-Score Differential Expression Analysis
This code will be used to evaluate the association between birthweight z-score and the placental transcriptome. We will not adjust for cell proportions in this version. This analysis is completed in CANDLE and PATHWAYS GAPPS (N=1009) 

### Load Packages
```{r load packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(edgeR)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(biomaRt)
```

### Load Data
```{r load data}
#Load Filtered Normalized RNAseq Data
load(file="/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/FilteredNormalized_RNAseq_CANDLEGAPPS_N1009_112125.RData")

#Loading the covariates for the N=1003 CANDLE/GAPPS Datasets
#This is the updated version with the BW_ZScores
load("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/CovariateData/FilteredCovariates_CANDLEGAPPS_111825.RData")
```

### Fix Data Class
```{r Covar Data Class Fix}
summary(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars)
#Fix covariates with empty factor levels
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Parity <- factor(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Parity, levels=c("0", "1"))
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$FetalSex <- factor(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$FetalSex, levels=c("F", "M"))
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$RaceCollapsed <- factor(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$RaceCollapsed, levels=c("1", "2", "3", "6", "7"))
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Ethnicity <- factor(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Ethnicity, levels=c("0", "1"))
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Batch <- factor(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Batch, levels=c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7"))

#Clean up empty factor levels
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars <-droplevels(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars)
summary(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars)

```


### Check Data Order
```{r}
identical(colnames(Y_norm$counts), CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$pathways_id)

```

### Run Differential Expression Analysis
For this analysis we will adjust for: Parity, Fetal Sex, Maternal Age, Maternal BMI, Maternal Race, Maternal Ethnicity, Maternal Education, Prenatal Smoking, Prenatal Alcohol Use, Labor Type, and Delivery Method, RNAseq Batch
```{r DEG Analysis}

mod <-model.matrix(~CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$bw_z
                   +CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Parity
                   +CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$FetalSex
                   +CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Age
                   +CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$BMI
                   +CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$RaceCollapsed
                   +CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Ethnicity
                   +CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$EducationCollapsed
                   +CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite
                   +CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Alcohol
                   +CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$LaborType
                   +CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$DeliveryMethod
                   +CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Batch
  )

  dim(mod)
  
  v<-voom(Y_norm, mod, plot=TRUE) 
  designMatrix<-v$design
fit <- eBayes(lmFit(v, designMatrix))
Results<-topTable(fit, coef=2,number=dim(fit)[1],adjust.method="BH") #Coefficent 2 is BW ZScore
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
hist(Results$P.Value,breaks=20)
plot(Results$logFC,-log(Results$P.Value, base=10),ylim=c(0,15),pch=16,cex=0.5,,ylab="Log P Value",xlab="logFC")
  Cutoff<-0.05/dim(Results)[1]
  abline(h=-log(Cutoff, base=10),lwd=2,lty=2,col="blue")
  abline(h=-log(0.05, base=10),lwd=1.5,lty=2,col="azure4")


#save(Results, file="/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/BirthweightTranscriptome/BWz_FullResults_noCellProp_112125.Rdata")
#write.csv(Results, "/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/BirthweightTranscriptome/BWz_FullResults_noCellProp_112125.csv")

```

### Volcano Plot
```{r vplot}
MakeVPlot <- function(Results, Title){
  # Filter for significant genes (FDR < 0.05)
  sig <- Results[Results$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]
  sig <- sig[order(sig$adj.P.Val), ]
  
  # Separate up and down regulated genes
  sig_up <- sig[sig$logFC > 0, ]
  sig_down <- sig[sig$logFC < 0, ]
  
  # Colors from RdBu palette
  ColorPalette <- brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[c(2:4, 8:10)]
  color_up <- ColorPalette[3]
  color_down <- ColorPalette[4]
  
  # Top 5 significant genes
  top5 <- head(sig, 10)
  
  # Create the plot
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  
  p <- ggplot(Results, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) +
    geom_point(color = "grey60", size = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = sig_up, color = color_up, size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(data = sig_down, color = color_down, size = 1.2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = top5, aes(label = genes),
                    size = 3,
                    max.overlaps = Inf,
                    box.padding = 0.4,
                    point.padding = 0.2,
                    segment.size = 0.3,
                    segment.color = "black") +
    labs(title = Title,
         x = "Effect Estimate",
         y = "Negative Log(p-value)") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.5, 0.5), ylim = c(0, 10.5)) +
    theme_bw() + 
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face="bold"))
  
  return(p)
}
MakeVPlot(Results, "Birthweight Z-Score")
```
